oneOf.description: Buyer-issued purchase order specifying PO, product, ordered quantity and original delivery schedule. A supplier delay notice or replacement price offer is not a purchase order.
Supplier notice explicitly changing delivery against an existing PO, with original and revised schedule when visible. Classify here even if it repeats purchase order quantities.
Supplier offer for replacement supply with price, capacity and arrival date. A quote does not confirm an executed purchase.
Any document outside the three definitions, including ambiguous or unrelated documents. Never force an unsupported class.
